title: "rungar scale-sets inspect"
description: "Show one scale set: in the configuration, in the daemon, on GitHub, and its runners"
---

Show one scale set: what the configuration says, what the daemon is doing with it, what GitHub has of it, and its runners on the fleet. A configured one ends with the runs-on line that targets it, for a workflow to copy.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar scale-sets inspect NAME [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--group string` | Runner group to look for it in on GitHub (default the configured one, or Default). |
| `--json` | Write JSON. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
